note: Per-endpoint overrides for .github/workflows/endpoint-liveness.yml. Some endpoints are not meaningfully probeable at their literal value -- a directory prefix has no index, an API rejects a bare GET. Without these the checker reports confident false positives, which trains people to ignore it. Keys are '<plugin-id>.<endpoint-key>'.

lists.base.why: base is a directory prefix; raw.githubusercontent.com serves no index for it and always 404s. Probe a file the app actually fetches instead.

iptv-org.base.why: base is a directory prefix with no index page; the app appends /<resource>.json.

eztv.api.why: the API requires query parameters; a bare GET hangs until timeout.

allanime.base.why: GraphQL API that only answers POST with the right Referer; a bare GET is 403 by design. 'blocked' here is normal, not a regression.

apibay.base.why: Cloudflare-fronted; datacenter IPs get challenged. Verify from a residential client before believing it is down.

nyaa.base.why: serves a WAF interstitial to datacenter IPs while remaining up for normal clients.

animepahe.base.why: DDoS-Guard fronted; datacenter IPs get challenged.
